purpose: Stateless engine that applies a list of TransitionPlans to the database, tracking per-table versions in shresta_table_migration_versions.
businessRules: On first run, creates shresta_table_migration_versions (table_name PK, version INTEGER, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ) if absent.
getTableVersion returns -1 when no row exists for a table, matching the Haskell convention for 'not yet migrated'.
walkPlanList iterates all plans with retry to resolve cross-table dependency ordering at runtime.
walkPlan skips transitions whose fromVersions do not include the current table version; logs 'perform' or 'skip' for each step.
setTableVersion upserts via ON CONFLICT (table_name) DO UPDATE so version tracking is idempotent.
All SQL from each Transition is executed within a single JDBC autoCommit=false transaction.
haskellEquivalent: executeTransitionPlanList / walkPlanList / walkPlan / getTableVersion / setTableVersion in Server.Migrations.Run
